correctness.rationale: The strictly increasing consecutive-one gaps g_j=(b−1)b^j uniquely identify any occurring two-one core. The one-sided initial pre-gap is l0=1, and later left-zero spans are g_(j−1)−1, giving exact minimal overhangs. Any MAW with >=4 ones would have two occurring maximal factors sharing at least two ones and hence the unique occurrence, contradiction; the three-one case gives only b=2 and b=3 exceptions. Counting pair-gap and boundary families yields the stated exact M_b(N) and N+log_b N+O(1); intersecting with 10*1 proves nonregularity via unbounded geometric gaps. Fifteen independently coded b=2..6 finite-prefix MAW set comparisons through N=20 matched predictions; finite testing is not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: The finite prefix checks, including 15 new cases, do not prove the infinite morphic theorem.
